entities.summary: Shehla Rashid Shora is a former Indian Kashmiri social activist, and former leader of the Jawaharlal Nehru University Students' Union (JNUSU). She rose to prominence whilst leading the student agitation calling for the release for Kanhaiya Kumar, Umar Khalid and others who were arrested on charges of sedition in February 2016 for participating and organizing sloganeering in JNU.
